about: Career stages (M19c), in order. Goals are judged at midnight on the days played. Jam goals use a news hotspot's roads: the mean speed as a share of the speed limit, weighted by length, from 07:00 to 09:00 (am) or 15:00 to 18:00 (pm), as the mean of the last two whole days; 'today' is that share in two day runs of today's roads (2026-11-01, seeds 1 and 2). Transit and traffic goals compare with the mean of the career's first two whole days. Grants are game balance, not real figures.

stages.name: First steps
stages.text: Zone land for homes and work, and keep the City's books in the black while it grows.

stages.name: Savska cesta
stages.text: Every afternoon traffic stands still on Savska cesta at Tratinska ulica. Get it moving.

stages.name: Trams and buses
stages.text: Win riders for ZET: more trips by tram and bus than when the career began.

stages.name: Novi Zagreb grows
stages.text: Let Novi Zagreb – zapad grow without the city's traffic getting worse.

stages.name: Slavonska avenija
stages.text: The morning queues where Slavonska avenija crosses Savska cesta, by the Vjesnik tower, are the City's best known. Clear them.
